messages:
emma: Morning poll: does semver mean anything or is it just ceremonial? :thinking_face:
rafael: ceremonial. we whisper to the changelog and move on. :pray:
dora: YAML joke: 'I have commitment issues; I keep changing indentation.' :laughing:
format-bot: Reminder: trailing spaces detected in 3 files. Want me to auto-fix? :robot_face:
emma: Found a package labeled v1.0.0-actually-unreleased. dependency hell level: medium. :sweat_smile:
rafael: compiler meme: 'Segfault at 0x0? That's a feature, not a bug.' :rofl:
dora: tiny vote: if PR title is just "fix" do you read the PR? yes/no/only-if-ci_fails
emma: only_if_ci_fails
format-bot: Auto-reply: ran formatter on the PR branch. No semver advice given. :sparkles:
rafael: Proposal: add :semver-shruggie: to the emoji set. :raised_hands:
dora: night folks, may your YAML parse and your builds be green. :crescent_moon:
